title: Tap Reveal Interaction
visual_rule: No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays. No legal content. No people. Pure UI motion graphic.

style.animation: tap ripple, card flip, soft reveal glow, shield confirmation

timeline.scene: Clean navy background. Small Singapenn-style logo top-left and Tamil Nadu Police-style logo top-right fade in subtly.
Four blank rounded cards appear in a neat grid. No text.
A soft gold tap ripple appears on the first card.
First card flips over and reveals a blank green-safe back surface. No words.
Second and third cards receive quick tap ripples.
Second and third cards flip open. Soft glow appears behind the revealed cards.
Fourth card gets a tap ripple and flips open. All four cards now glow softly.
timeline.animation: final card flip, gentle completion glow

timeline.scene: A transparent shield outline forms behind the four cards. Cards settle calmly.
timeline.animation: shield outline forms and fades slightly

purpose: Reusable background or inline animation for tap-to-reveal interactions.

title: Drag Sort Interaction
visual_rule: No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays. No legal content. No people. Pure UI motion graphic.

style.color_palette: navy, gold, white, soft green, muted amber
style.animation: draggable cards, drop zones, snap, correct placement glow

timeline.scene: Clean light background with subtle navy frame. Logos fade in at top corners.
Five blank draggable cards appear at the bottom. Two blank drop zones appear above. No text.
First card lifts slightly with a soft gold outline.
First card moves into the left drop zone and snaps into place.
Second card moves into the right drop zone and snaps into place.
Three remaining cards move quickly one by one into the two zones.
All placed cards glow with a soft green confirmation pulse. No checkmark text.
Drop zones merge into a shield-shaped learning badge. No words.
timeline.animation: zones morph into shield, fade gently

purpose: Reusable visual for drag-and-drop sorting exercises.

title: Correct Answer Feedback
visual_rule: No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays. No legal content. No people. Pure success feedback animation.

style.visual_style: restrained success animation for serious e-learning
style.animation: soft pulse, shield check shape, gold particles, no confetti overload

timeline.scene: Clean navy background with subtle logos at top corners.
A blank answer card appears in the center.
Soft green glow begins around the card.
A simple shield outline forms behind the card.
A check-shaped gold stroke appears inside the shield. No text.
Small restrained gold particles rise slowly around the shield.
Card, shield, and check hold steady with a soft green pulse.
Everything settles and fades to a clean background.

purpose: Reusable animation for correct answers and completed interactions.

title: Caution / Try Again Feedback
visual_rule: No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays. No legal content. No people. Use caution without fear.

style.visual_style: restrained caution animation for serious learning
style.color_palette: navy, gold, white, muted amber, very soft red only as accent
style.animation: soft amber pulse, card shake, reset loop, no scary warning

timeline.scene: Clean white/navy background with subtle logos at top corners.
A blank answer card appears in the center.
The card receives a soft amber outline.
The card makes a very small side-to-side correction motion.
A small abstract caution triangle appears beside the card, without text.
The caution triangle dissolves into a curved retry arrow.
The card returns to neutral, ready to be tried again.
timeline.animation: outline returns from amber to gold

timeline.scene: Final calm frame: blank card, soft gold border, no warning.

purpose: Reusable animation for incorrect answer, incomplete interaction, or try-again feedback.

title: Module Complete Celebration
visual_rule: No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays. No legal content. No people. Official, respectful completion animation.

style.color_palette: deep navy, gold, white, soft green
style.animation: certificate paper, shield emblem, soft gold particles, calm completion glow

timeline.scene: Deep navy background. Logos fade in subtly at top corners.
A clean blank certificate paper slides gently into the center. No text.
Gold border draws around the certificate.
A shield emblem outline appears above the certificate.
A subtle check stroke forms inside the shield.
Small gold particles rise slowly behind the certificate, restrained and official.
Certificate and shield glow together with soft green and gold light.
Final clean completion frame: certificate, shield, logos, no text.

purpose: Reusable final completion animation for certificate or module-complete moment.
